result:
Section 4 (Health/HealthKit) is implemented and verified end-to-end on the iOS Simulator:

- **`app/native/healthkit.ts`** — a thin wrapper around the native `HKHealthStore` API (authorization status, request authorization, save a 500-step sample, load 7-day daily totals via `HKSampleQuery`).
- **`app/components/Health.vue`** — wired the placeholder UI to that module: status line reflects auth state and refreshes on `navigatedTo`, `Log 500 Steps` enabled only when granted, the 7-row list (or "Health access needed") renders with exact `Weekday Mon D — N,NNN steps` formatting and today's row emphasized.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSHealthShareUsageDescription`/`NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription`.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/app.entitlements`** (new) — `com.apple.developer.healthkit`.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/build.xcconfig`** — linked `HealthKit.framework` via `OTHER_LDFLAGS`.
- **`types/references.d.ts`** — pulled in the full `@nativescript/types-ios` typings (the default subset excludes HealthKit).

`ns build ios` succeeds, and I drove the app on-device via `idb`: fresh install shows "not requested" with disabled log button, requesting access shows the real system HealthKit consent sheet with our usage text, granting shows "granted" plus a live 7-day list, logging twice correctly accumulates to 5,000 steps with proper thousands-separator formatting (I caught and fixed a bug where `toLocaleString` wasn't inserting commas on this JS engine — replaced with manual formatting), data persists across relaunch, denying shows "denied" with the list replaced by "Health access needed" and no crash, and Back navigation to Home works.
